title: helleborus odorus subsp. cyclophyllus
intro: Helleborus odorus subsp. cyclophyllus, commonly known as the Corsican hellebore, is a subspecies of the hellebore plant, belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and infections. The therapeutic actions of the Corsican hellebore include analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, making it a potential treatment for pain relief, muscle spasms, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the Corsican hellebore include alkaloids, such as helleborin and hellebrin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
